scenario: [LNLS.3.3c] — a multi-pattern rule with no cross-pattern equality is refused under +nolinscan: the one cross-pattern comparison is `>`, which pins nothing, so the join degenerates to a scan. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.anchor_body`'s last arm — `key_equalities` finds no `==` between the two bindings. Counting any cross-pattern comparison as an equality would move this to DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_JOIN_ANCHOR_A.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Device scope logical:
    device_id: String key
    level: Int mutable

schema Reading scope logical:
    device_id: String key
    amount: Int mutable

rule joined:
    Device d
    Reading x where x.amount > d.level
->
    log info "x"
